title: Xanthe and the Debt
author: Orsen Nakamura
blurb: Zephyrine Voss, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
